compos.summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays a notification regarding firmware updates for the Pocket Photo device. The main contents and functions of this UI screen include:

1. **Notification Title**: "Notice" - indicating an important message.
2. **Firmware Update Information**: Instructions on how to update the Pocket Photo firmware via the Pocket Photo exclusive app by navigating to Setting -> Device Info.
3. **Performance and Quality Note**: A recommendation to update to the latest firmware for optimal performance and screen quality.
4. **Specific Model Update Instructions**: Information on updating the firmware for PD221 or PD233 models by downloading the tool from www.lge.com.
5. **New Feature Announcement**: Introduction of the "Shake & print" function with a reference to 'Setting' -> 'Help' for more details.
6. **Checkbox Option**: A checkbox to prevent this notification from appearing again ("Do not show this again").
7. **Action Buttons**: Two buttons at the bottom - "Check update
